raw.query: WITH current_dim AS (SELECT * FROM provenance.v_dim WHERE is_current = true AND superseded_by IS NULL), replay_set(run_id, episode, planner) AS (VALUES ('episode:burst1_fc','burst1','forecast'),('episode:burst1_re','burst1','reactive'),('live:twin_fc_p90','burst3','forecast'),('live:twin_re','burst3','reactive'),('episode:burst4_fc','burst4','forecast'),('episode:burst4_re','burst4','reactive'),('episode:burst5_fc','burst5','forecast'),('episode:burst5_re','burst5','reactive')), evidence AS (SELECT r.episode, r.planner, d.quantile, i.bound_ms, i.achieved_p99_ms, i.is_violation FROM current_dim d JOIN replay_set r USING (run_id) JOIN provenance.v_infraction i USING (run_id) WHERE i.is_current = true AND i.sla_metric = 'ttft' AND i.bound_stat = 'p99') SELECT planner, COUNT(*) AS episode_count, ROUND(MIN(achieved_p99_ms)) AS min_ttft_p99_ms, ROUND(MAX(achieved_p99_ms)) AS max_ttft_p99_ms, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_violation) AS pass_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_violation) AS fail_count, MIN(bound_ms) AS service_floor_ms, ARRAY_AGG(episode ORDER BY episode) AS episodes, ARRAY_AGG(ROUND(achieved_p99_ms)::bigint ORDER BY episode) AS rounded_ttft_p99_ms FROM evidence GROUP BY planner ORDER BY planner
raw.observed: Forecast: 4/4 pass, TTFT p99 651-706 ms; reactive: 4/4 fail, TTFT p99 1,615-3,495 ms; service floor 1,000 ms.
raw.claimed: Forecast passes all four at 651-706 ms; reactive fails all four at 1,615-3,495 ms.
raw.evidence: Current, non-superseded v_infraction records for burst1, burst3, burst4, and burst5 exactly reproduce both rounded ranges and all pass/fail outcomes.
